title: Post-closure parallel-lane expansion manifest
rule: Maintain separate landscape and closure ledgers. A typed equivalence, classification, model, obstruction or experimental analogue may advance understanding even when it does not close a physical bridge. Stronger predictive or ontological claims still require source, action and observable consequences.

lanes.name: Measurement-first inverse problem
lanes.typed_start: A pair of operational source protocols and measured response functionals, not an abstract basis of a two-dimensional vector space.
lanes.first_executable_test: Specify two gauge-invariant laboratory source functionals, construct their linear-response kernel, and test whether the normalized balanced observable is invariant under allowed source-frame shear.
lanes.promotion_criterion: The protocols select a unique frame and orientation and yield a no-refit dimensionless observable.
lanes.falsifier: The measured quantity can be changed continuously by recalibrating the two sources or is insensitive to the topology assignment.

lanes.name: Renormalization-group and OPE closure
lanes.typed_start: The complete basis of local gauge-singlet vector operators mixing with the incidence and B-L currents in a declared Standard-Model renormalization scheme.
lanes.first_executable_test: Enumerate all dimension-three gauge-singlet vector operators modulo equations of motion and total derivatives, then calculate the leading Yukawa breaking and one-loop mixing allowed by quantum numbers.
lanes.promotion_criterion: The candidate two-plane is RG invariant or flows to a uniquely normalized eigenframe.
lanes.falsifier: Additional operators mix in irreducibly or the frame runs by unconstrained finite transformations.

lanes.name: Nonperturbative lattice and functional response
lanes.typed_start: Euclidean correlators of explicitly gauge-invariant current operators with a controlled continuum and infinite-volume limit.
lanes.first_executable_test: Build a small gauge-covariant domain-wall or overlap-fermion lattice model carrying the anomaly-free source pair and measure the 2x2 Euclidean correlator and its rank under lattice refinement.
lanes.promotion_criterion: A stable continuum response selects a reproducible eigenframe or spectral relation not imposed by the discretization.
lanes.falsifier: The result is regulator-dependent, mirror contaminated, or collapses to generic positive covariance data.

lanes.name: Boundary theory and anomaly inflow
lanes.typed_start: A local higher-dimensional bulk action with a boundary whose chiral zero modes reproduce one anomaly-free Standard-Model generation.
lanes.first_executable_test: Write one finite-slab gauge action with the complete anomaly-free generation, calculate its inflow, mirror spectrum and boundary two-current response, and test whether the wall normal fixes the orientation witness.
lanes.promotion_criterion: The bulk removes mirror propagation, fixes orientation, and reduces to the audited four-dimensional response without arbitrary boundary counterterms.
lanes.falsifier: Mirror modes persist or anomaly cancellation requires spectator data unrelated to the Furey carrier.

lanes.name: Spectral triple and graded superconnection
lanes.typed_start: A finite real even spectral triple or graded superconnection whose Hilbert space is the audited chiral matter module and whose Dirac data generate the admitted Yukawa and source operators.
lanes.first_executable_test: Construct the smallest finite graded Hilbert space and test the order-zero, first-order, reality and orientability conditions while forbidding charged bare pairings and reproducing the four Higgs-dressed Yukawa channels.
lanes.promotion_criterion: The axioms reduce the free Dirac/source data and derive the same physical two-channel map used by the response theory.
lanes.falsifier: The finite Dirac operator simply stores arbitrary masses, mixings and selector data or requires mirror doubling incompatible with the audited module.

lanes.name: Amplitude and bootstrap constraints
lanes.typed_start: On-shell amplitudes or spectral sum rules with explicitly declared asymptotic Standard-Model states and source insertions.
lanes.first_executable_test: Classify the lowest-point form factors of the incidence and B-L currents and determine whether locality, crossing, unitarity and the proposed orientation remove any independent Wilson coefficient.
lanes.promotion_criterion: One residue, sign, zero or sum-rule coefficient is fixed beyond generic unitarity and Standard-Model symmetry.
lanes.falsifier: All coefficients remain independent EFT data or the purported relation is a generic positive-real/scattering identity.

lanes.name: Modular and operator-algebraic reconstruction
lanes.typed_start: A concrete von Neumann algebra of local observables, a cyclic separating state, and a specified inclusion or conditional expectation associated with the candidate two-channel subsystem.
lanes.first_executable_test: Build a finite or free-field standard-pair model and calculate its modular conjugation and modular flow; test whether they induce the required real slice, source/dual pairing and orientation without a separately chosen conjugation.
lanes.promotion_criterion: The state and inclusion uniquely produce the selector and reversal operation used by the physical response.
lanes.falsifier: Changing the faithful state continuously rotates the selected real form or the modular data have no Standard-Model operator interpretation.

lanes.name: Defect and topological response
lanes.typed_start: A physical defect, interface or pump parameter coupled to a gapped family of local operators, with the complete parameter domain and boundary conditions declared.
lanes.first_executable_test: Combine the established defect angle with the causal frequency response and compute a mixed invariant on the full compactified frequency-defect domain, including every pole, zero and gap closing.
lanes.promotion_criterion: The invariant forces a boundary zero mode or orientation-odd transport coefficient tied to a physical Standard-Model defect.
lanes.falsifier: The invariant vanishes after correct compactification or depends on a coordinate not generated by the action.

lanes.name: Emergent and analogue response
lanes.typed_start: A microscopic many-body or hydrodynamic model with experimentally addressable two-port observables whose collective response realizes the same Jordan cone.
lanes.first_executable_test: Construct the smallest mechanical, acoustic or hydrodynamic two-port model with the programme's selector and orientation reversal, then identify which observables are generic and which require the special coupling graph.
lanes.promotion_criterion: A laboratory analogue realizes and discriminates the two topology assignments through a robust response relation.
lanes.falsifier: Every effect is reproducible by an arbitrary reciprocal two-port and carries no information about the proposed matter/topology map.
